name: Sudarshana Chakra
description: This chakra will cause the Hero's Ultimate to deal an extra 20/25/30/35/40/45/50% damage.

name: Axe of Pangu
description: While holding this axe, every auto-attack, there is a 25% chance to deal an extra 60/75/90/105/120/135/150% damage to the target. This damage is treated as Health Removal.

name: Staff of Sharur
description: While wearing this staff, Hero will deal an extra 28/35/42/49/56/63/63% damage to an enemy with less than 50% Health. Bonus damage to bosses is halved but no health condition applies.

name: Yasakani Magatama
description: With this magatama equipped, after the Hero uses an active skill, there is a 30/36/42/48/54/60/66% chance to halve the cooldown of the same skill next time.

name: Excalibur
description: While the wearer of this sword is alive, increase the Attack and Defense of all ally Heroes by 4/5/6/7/8/9/10% (effect is not stackable).

name: Thor's Hammer
description: While the hammer holder is being attacked, there is a 15% chance the opponent's hit will reduce their Attack Speed by 30/35/40/45/50/55% for 2s.

name: Scarab Badge
description: The wearer of this badge recovers 20/25/30/35/40/45/50% of max Health after it drops below 30% for the first time. Additionally, damage taken is reduced by 30% for 5s.

name: Aegis Shield
description: This shield blocks damage 13/16/19/22/25/28/31% of the time for the wearer.
